title: Your toothbrush is worn-out!
summary: Ben Krasnow of Applied Science uses a scanning electron microscope to compare new and worn toothbrush bristles. He shows how the microscopic texturing wears down with use.
why: HN commenters link it for electron micrographs of fresh versus worn bristles when toothbrush wear comes up.

quote.text: You can find electron microscope scans of fresh toothbrushes and worn ones in this[0] Applied Science YouTube video.
